solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; clues and answers read from cryptics.georgeho.org (ODbL)'s copy of the post

clue.text: Precious stone from a Queen, you said — a queen in Eastern state

indicators.note: the word you is spoken here, and spoken aloud it is the single letter that names it

parts.note: the pronoun, whose spoken form is a letter
the second article, used as written

indicators.note: the queen sits inside the name of the state

parts.note: Maine is a state on the east coast of the USA
R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A jeweller traces a gem's history back to a royal owner abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: This blue-green gemstone is a variety of beryl, so it counts as a precious stone.

clue.text: Pain repeatedly showing up in each extra check-up

indicators.note: the answer appears inside the run of words that follows, spanning the gap between them

parts.note: the answer runs across the join of these words

explanation.surface: A patient complains that discomfort keeps appearing at every extra medical examination.
explanation.definitionFit: A dull continuous pain is the standard synonym, used as a noun here.

clue.text: What comes from 12 that we hear is faulty

parts.note: the answer to 12 across is the United Nations, abbreviated to two letters
what we hear is sound; what comes from the body is its noise

explanation.surface: Whatever we hear issuing from the global body is flawed.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsound reasoning or structure is defective and unreliable, so the adjective is a synonym of faulty.

clue.text: Rich person is involved with oil and minerals

indicators.note: letters that are involved get mixed together, so the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wealthy figure has interests in oil and mining.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman worth a million or more is by any standard a wealthy individual.

clue.text: Get back through payment that's concerning judge

parts.note: re is the short Latin-derived word meaning about, as in a letter heading
to deem is to judge or consider

explanation.surface: Someone recovers an item by paying, in a matter involving a judge.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover something such as a pawned item by paying for it is the original sense of this verb.

clue.text: Spotted I am taking place — that's totally upset candidates

indicators.note: the whole string, upset from bottom to top in a down clue, is read backwards

parts.note: an event that is on is happening

explanation.surface: Someone spots themselves joining the field while everything is in turmoil at selection time.
explanation.definitionFit: Those put forward for election or an award are its nominees, i.e. the candidates.

clue.text: Finish second best

parts.note: the top performer is the best

explanation.surface: A competitor ends up as the runner-up to the best.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop is to bring to an end or cease, a plain synonym of the verb finish.

clue.text: Gambling activity raised plenty — infiltrated by Mob, unfortunately

indicators.note: something infiltrated has another thing slipped inside it
in a down answer, lifting a word up means reading it from the bottom, i.e. backwards
signals that the letters of mob come out in an unlucky jumbled order

explanation.surface: A charity draw made a lot of money until gangsters muscled in.
explanation.walkthrough: A tombola is a raffle where tickets are drawn from a revolving drum, common at British fetes.
explanation.definitionFit: This lottery game with prizes drawn from a drum is a form of gambling.

clue.text: It's consumed by airborne soldier, NCO, taking advantage of host

indicators.note: the expanded words are swallowed inside the officer's letters

parts.note: SM is a sergeant major, a non-commissioned officer
expanded to its full form, it is

explanation.surface: A paratrooper sergeant eats up something while exploiting someone's hospitality.
explanation.walkthrough: It's must be expanded to two words; the shorter version leaves one letter short.
explanation.definitionFit: Parasitism is living off another organism, its host, as a noun for the exploitation.

clue.text: Under pressure, is prepared for journey over snow

definitions.text: is prepared for journey over snow
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: has a sled, so is ready to travel over snow

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into has plus sled and it describes someone equipped for a snowy trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone harried and pestered is stressed, i.e. under pressure, while the split phrase describes owning a sledge.

clue.text: Man mistreated in army badly, in country out East

indicators.note: one jumble is placed inside the other
the letters of army are put in a bad order
the letters of man are treated roughly and rearranged

explanation.surface: A man is abused within a badly run army in a far-off land.
explanation.definitionFit: This Southeast Asian nation, formerly Burma, lies in the Far East.

clue.text: A very little changed about new area, otherwise

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the two abbreviations
the letters of the phrase are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Things have barely changed in the new district, or else they have.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words introduce another possibility, as in or else, so alternatively is a synonym adverb.

clue.text: Global organisation, it's insinuated, not needing reform

indicators.note: letters needing re-forming are rearranged into a new shape

explanation.surface: Someone hints that the world body is perfectly fine and needs no changes.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface says no reform is needed, but needing reform is the instruction to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: This international body of member states is the best-known worldwide organisation.

clue.text: Highly prized around company, showing early talent

indicators.note: the word for treasured goes around the abbreviation

explanation.surface: A valued member of a firm shows signs of ability young.
explanation.definitionFit: A precocious child develops abilities unusually early, which is talent shown early.

clue.text: I had brought in toll for old county division

indicators.note: the contraction is brought inside the sound of a bell

parts.note: a bell's toll is its ring

explanation.surface: Someone collected a road charge for a historic administrative area.
explanation.walkthrough: Yorkshire was historically split into three ridings: North, East and West.
explanation.definitionFit: A riding was one of the administrative thirds of the old English county of Yorkshire.

clue.text: Clear about regions in part of Asia

indicators.note: the word for clear profit goes about the districts

parts.note: net as in clear profit, what is left after deductions

explanation.surface: Districts in an Asian zone are being cleared.
explanation.definitionFit: The Near East is the old name for the region of western Asia around the eastern Mediterranean.

clue.text: Wellington, for example, wrongly ordered to war with foe

definitions.note: a collective noun defined by one example, a boot

indicators.note: the letters are put in a wrong order

explanation.surface: The Duke of Wellington was mistakenly sent to battle an enemy.
explanation.walkthrough: Wellington looks like the Iron Duke; it is the rubber boot named after him.
explanation.definitionFit: A wellington is a waterproof rubber boot, one example of things worn on the feet.

clue.text: Alloy moulded into cars

indicators.note: metal moulded takes a new shape, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A metal is shaped into vehicles at a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast iron is an iron-carbon mixture, a metallic alloy poured into moulds.

clue.text: Because, for example, ultimately it's genuine

parts.note: since can mean because, as in since you asked

indicators.note: the last letter of each of the two words is taken

parts.note: the two words supply their final letters

explanation.surface: Something is real, because, for instance, it is the final outcome.
explanation.walkthrough: For example reads as e.g., but here it is two words supplying their final letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincere feelings are honest and heartfelt, so the adjective is a synonym of genuine.

clue.text: French writer without penny getting university position

indicators.note: in its old sense of outside, the writer's name surrounds the coin

parts.note: Albert Camus, the French author of The Outsider

explanation.surface: A penniless French author lands an academic post.
explanation.walkthrough: Without looks like it means lacking, but here it means outside, so the penny goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: A campus is the grounds and buildings of a university, its physical site.

clue.text: Writes home about old, old person's financial support

indicators.note: the word for at home goes about the letter for old

explanation.surface: An elderly person writes home about money support.
explanation.definitionFit: A pension is the regular payment made to someone retired, their income in old age.

clue.text: Person travelling a lot around South lifted fruit

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting means reading upwards, i.e. backwards
the wanderer goes around the compass point

parts.note: a nomad roams from place to place

explanation.surface: A wanderer heading south picks some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A damson is a small dark plum, a kind of fruit.

clue.text: Study change in US helping effort to focus

parts.note: to con is to study carefully
a cent is a coin, small change, in American money
a ration is a portion or helping

explanation.surface: Studying the American currency system takes real focus.
explanation.walkthrough: Change looks like a verb, but it means loose coins.
explanation.definitionFit: Concentration is the mental effort of fixing attention on something, i.e. focusing.

clue.text: Story of Julius Caesar, say — power and destiny

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's tragedy is about power and fate.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on two senses: the storyline of a play, and the conspiracy against Caesar.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot is the storyline of a play, and the conspiracy against Caesar was itself a plot.

clue.text: Supervise parts of test European repeated

parts.note: overs are six-ball sets in a cricket test match
the European abbreviation is given again

explanation.surface: An official monitors a cricket test featuring the same European twice.
explanation.walkthrough: A cricket over is a set of six balls bowled from one end; a test is a long international match.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversee is to watch over and manage, a straightforward synonym of supervise.

clue.text: Place is unusually unusual

indicators.note: the letters are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A location is remarkably out of the ordinary.
explanation.definitionFit: Something special is exceptional, out of the ordinary, so it is a synonym of unusual.

clue.text: Small building that woman had abandoned

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a simple hut or outbuilding
third meaning: cast off, as a snake its skin

explanation.walkthrough: Three readings of one word: a noun, a contraction of she had, and a past-tense verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A shed is a small hut for storage; she'd contracts she had; to shed is to cast off.

clue.text: Bad way to tie relative to king? On the contrary

parts.note: granny is an informal word for grandmother

explanation.surface: A poor link between a relative and the monarch, or is it the reverse?
explanation.definitionFit: A granny knot is a reef knot tied wrongly so it slips, a notoriously poor way of tying.
